plan.title: Edit evaluation time with far-future date

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with Vendor A's bid; prepared-state plans must start here.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required RFQ counter-offer configuration.
Apply the required bidding-time rejection configuration.
Enable buyer editing of bidding fields as required.
Enable percentage counter offers as required by the case.
Move to the RFQ stage whose evaluation time is being edited.
Open the Responses view specified by the case.
Open the RFQ Settings action and select Edit Evaluation Time.

args.goal: In the open Edit Evaluation Time window, choose the custom duration option, enter the excessively large future evaluation end date 31 December 2100 23:59, click Ok, and stop with the resulting validation message, refusal, or saved result visible.

steps.note: Perform the exact absolute-date interaction that no catalog step can parameterize.
Assert that the resulting screen has no crash, server error, NaN, undefined, null, or raw-id rendering.
